'''Ardos disks''' were small coins composed of [[Aurodium/Legends|aurodium]] collected from [[Varl/Legends|Varl]]. The disks bore a stylized image of the star [[Ardos/Legends|Ardos]] on one side and the sigil of the [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] that issued the disk on the other. Ardos disks were given as rewards to highly favored servants and emissaries of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] Lords, as well as those who were victorious in the [[Granee Noopa]].<ref name="LoNH" />

Ardos disks identified the bearer as being under the protection of the disk's issuer, and for a Hutt to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the possessor of an Ardos disk was nearly as taboo as the murder of another Hutt; most Hutts and their servants honored the relative immunity afforded those given such a rare boon. Conversely, the theft or forgery of an Ardos disk was seen as a heinous act among the Hutts.<ref name="LoNH" />
